actions.rock.generate: Makes a new rock, or updates the rock that is selected
actions.rock.reset_settings: Puts every setting back to its default

notes: What Rock does best is big fractured faces. For fine crags over the whole surface, expect to finish with Blender's own modifiers.
base_shape CUBE chips well. SPHERE barely chips at usual settings and can come back as a smooth ball.

adaptive_subdiv off leaves a few hundred vertices, too few for the surface detail settings to show. On adds vertices unevenly: they gather along edges, the big cut faces stay flat, and the count swings from under 1,000 to over 100,000. Strong detail values grow spikes.
Its mesh has open edges and very large faces, so Blender's Voxel Remesh can shred it. The SHARP remesh mode has held up.
size is only a starting point: the cuts decide the final size, and size 6 has given 3.6 to 7.6 m. Read size in the reply after every run. On SPHERE, size is the radius, not the width.
The origin is not reliably the centre, so use lowest_z in the reply to rest the rock on the ground.
chip_radius works the other way round from its description: a lower value cuts less.
subdivisions changes little once the rock has been cut.
